title: Sr Assembler
description: Seeking hands-on individuals with a strong curiosity about technology and a keen attention to detail. Responsibilities include working in a cleanroom environment, assembling sophisticated systems, and collaborating within a diverse team. A flexible, eager-to-learn attitude is essential, along with a desire for career growth in the technology field.

title: Director, Materials Management
description: Join our team as a Director of Materials Management, where you will lead strategic supplier partnerships and drive supply chain transformations. If you have a strong background in materials management and a passion for optimizing processes, we want to hear from you!

title: Process Engineer II DSP, Manufacturing Sciences
description: Join our team as a Process Engineer II DSP, where you'll contribute to ensuring consistent production of therapeutic products. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and ensure robust manufacturing processes that meet quality standards.

title: Director, Strategic Initiatives Product Cost Innovation
description: Join our team as Director, Strategic Initiatives Product Cost Innovation and lead transformative cost-out and efficiency programs. Drive cross-functional collaboration, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence in a global organization. Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain innovation while working with senior leadership and making a real impact on our mission to enable customers healthier, cleaner, and safer.

title: Head of ISC Process Excellence and Transformation
description: Join our team as Head of ISC Process Excellence and Transformation, leading global process standardization, data governance, and digital strategy for integrated supply chain excellence. Drive innovation, manage a world-class team, and deliver measurable value through advanced planning, analytics, and operational transformation. Shape the future of supply chain at Thermo Fisher Scientific.

title: Director Operations Electron Microscopy, Eindhoven
description: Join our team as Director, Operations – Electron Microscopy and lead high-impact manufacturing for advanced TEM systems. Drive operational excellence, ensure regulatory compliance, and champion continuous improvement in a dynamic, low-volume environment. Shape the future of high-tech manufacturing with Thermo Fisher Scientific in Eindhoven. Ready to make an impact as a leader? Apply now!

title: Teamlead
description: Join our team as a Team Leader in Manufacturing at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll lead a dedicated group of professionals in a quality-focused environment. Drive operational excellence and foster a culture of innovation while ensuring safety and efficiency in the production of cutting-edge scientific instruments.

title: Operations Engineer
description: Embrace the role of an Operations Engineer and play a key role in manufacturing high-tech Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)s. Collaborate with R&D and logistics teams, streamline production, and ensure top-quality standards. Grow your career in a dynamic, innovative environment supporting breakthrough discoveries in nanotechnology and life sciences.

title: Technician II MBP
description: Embrace the opportunity to become a Formulation Technician II and play a vital role in preparing and optimizing buffer and media solutions for life sciences research and biopharmaceutical manufacturing. If you have a background in aseptic techniques and cGMP standards, this is your chance to contribute to innovative projects in a dynamic, quality-driven environment.

title: Technisch Medewerker -dagdienst-40 uur/wk
description: We are looking for een Set-up Technician die verantwoordelijk is voor het klaarzetten van productie en het uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud aan machines. Je werkt in een schone omgeving en zorgt voor de kwaliteit van de productiemiddelen. Ervaring met GMP/FDA is een pré.

title: Operator II
description: We are looking for een Operator II bij Thermo Fisher Scientific in Tilburg. Je zult werken in een dynamische omgeving waar je verantwoordelijk bent voor de productie van softgel capsules, met een focus op kwaliteitsbewustzijn en GMP-normen.

title: Operator II
description: Als je deel uitmaakt van het team van Thermo Fisher Scientific, doe je belangrijk werk en je krijgt de kans om voortdurend te groeien en te leren in een cultuur die je ontwikkeling stimuleert....

title: Lifecycle planner
description: Embrace the opportunity to become a Lifecycle Planner and drive end-to-end planning for service parts across the product lifecycle. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, optimize inventory, and ensure service readiness in a dynamic, high-tech environment. Shape strategies that meet customer needs and support innovation at Thermo Fisher Scientific.

title: Sr Test Technician
description: Are you looking for a hands-on role in a cleanroom environment where you can align and test sophisticated electromechanical systems? Ideal candidates will have a strong technical interest, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills, contributing to high-quality standards and customer satisfaction. Flexible hours and career growth opportunities await!

title: Validation Engineer II, Production Equipment & Utilities GMP
description: Are you experienced in validation engineering? Join our team as a Validation Engineer II at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you will ensure compliance and excellence in equipment and process validation within a dynamic pharmaceutical environment.

title: Mechanical Category Cost Specialist
description: Embrace the opportunity to become a Mechanical Category Cost Specialist and drive impactful cost modeling, supplier engagement, and strategic sourcing initiatives. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize supply chain performance, reduce costs, and support global procurement standards. Shape the future of manufacturing excellence with Thermo Fisher Scientific.

title: Project Manager
description: We are looking for an experienced and strategic Project Manager to lead cross-functional teams in the execution of pharmaceutical development and commercialization projects. Join us to manage complex programs across drug discovery, clinical development, regulatory submission, and manufacturing scale-up.

title: Mechanical Assembler
description: Seeking detail-oriented individuals with a background in mechanics or electronics, eager to tackle technical challenges in a cleanroom environment. Responsibilities include assembling system modules, troubleshooting, and ensuring quality delivery. Candidates should possess strong communication skills and a proactive mindset, with at least 2 years of relevant experience.

title: Operator II
description: We are looking for een betrokken en verantwoordelijke Operator die passie voor productie graag in praktijk brengt. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen binnen een cultuur die jouw groei ondersteunt.

title: Operations  Engineer – TEM Vacuum Technology
description: Embrace the role of an Operations Engineer – TEM Vacuum Technology and drive innovation in high-vacuum systems. Leverage your expertise in vacuum engineering, technical support, and process improvement to ensure customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. Be part of a dynamic environment where your hands-on skills and problem-solving abilities will make a real impact.

title: Maintenance Technician (Onderhoudsmonteur)
description: We are looking for een Onderhoudsmonteur die complexe mechanische en elektrische storingen kan oplossen en preventief onderhoud kan uitvoeren in een moderne farmaceutische omgeving. Je werkt met high-tech productiemachines en draagt bij aan de gezondheid van miljoenen patiënten wereldwijd.
